notes.title: Get ready to have fun with Fusion!
notes.notes: [p]Hi! I’m the developer of Evolvania. [/p][p]I’ve been working hard on the game and I’m excited to finally share one of its most important features: a system that lets you fuse your weapons with elements you find in the world. [/p][p][/p][p]You can combine countless objects with your weapons, each one adding unique modifications and behaviors. This creates endless possibilities and makes both combat and exploration more varied than ever. [/p][p][/p][p]Fusion also changes the way you explore environments. For example, if you come across a stone wall, you will need to fuse with stone to break through. That is just a simple example so I do not spoil the real surprises waiting in your adventure.[/p]
